Strategy: Scaled dual dead-zone avoidance. Exact fits score highest; tiny residuals below a quarter of the item and awkward residuals between half and the full item lose half the item, while others rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in either zone while a looser bin avoids both. It may help by avoiding two kinds of unusable leftovers, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item / 2 if (r - item < item / 4 or (r - item > item / 2 and r - item <= item)) else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Scaled dual dead-zone avoidance: penalize residual < item/4 and residual in (item/2, item] by item/2.
